statement.p: If f(x) is the slope of a trail at a distance x miles from the start of the trail, what does \int_{3}^{\,5} {f(x)}\,dx represent?

li.p: The change in elevation between x = 3 mi and x = 5 mi from the start of the trail.
The change in elevation over the first three miles of the trail.
The length of the trail between x = 3 mi and x = 5 mi from the start of the trail.
The length of the first 3 miles of the trail.
